answer: Give every identity a dune of its own past work: a long, public trail of earlier answers that only its key can extend. Each epoch, require the identity to build on its own trail, answering a question that refers back to what it wrote before. Reaching the summit of standing takes a coherent history no newcomer can buy, and a beacon check compares new text against the old for consistency. One operator running ten fakes must maintain ten separate, non-contradictory histories, and any copied or shared memory betrays the cluster at once.
